say:0:1660212001:2.text: You defuse a conflict just before it can escalate, but then...
say:0:1660212001:2.source_cn: 你消弭了一场即将升级的冲突，然而……
say:0:1660212001:2.male: You defuse a conflict just before it can escalate, but then...
say:0:1660212001:2.female: You defuse a conflict just before it can escalate, but then...

say:2:1660212002:0.text: Outsiders, stay out of this. This is our problem, not yours.
say:2:1660212002:0.source_cn: 外来者，这是夏日部落的事，别插手。

say:3:1660212003:0.text: We don't mean to meddle, but fighting won't fix anything... There has to be another way.
say:3:1660212003:0.source_cn: 我们无意冒犯，只是……挥舞拳头并不能彻底解决问题。

say:6:1660212005:0.text: W-We're refugees... from the Sunlit Tribe...
say:6:1660212005:0.source_cn: 我们、我们是从烈阳部落逃出来的……

say:7:1660212006:0.text: Soren, get away from them! Their tribe was destroyed by the summer curse. You want to bring that here?!
say:7:1660212006:0.source_cn: 索恩，快离开他们！烈阳部落就是因为夏日诅咒才毁灭的，你...

say:8:1660212007:1.text: We're not cursed! We've been traveling for days. If we carried the curse, we'd be dead already!
say:8:1660212007:1.source_cn: 我们没有感染，我们从那么远的地方过来，如果感染了诅咒，...

say:9:1660212008:1.text: The moment they mention the "Sunlit Tribe", the crowd gets agitated. No one listens. More and more Maulers from the Summer Tribe gather.
say:9:1660212008:1.source_cn: 当这些蛮血说出烈阳部落那一刻，没有人听得进他们的辩解了...

say:10:1660212009:1.text: Their faces are twisted with fury, eyes blazing. It's as if they want to tear the Sunlit Tribe refugees apart.
say:10:1660212009:1.source_cn: 他们表情凶狠地看着那群烈阳部落蛮血，似乎恨不得吃他们的...

say:12:1660212010:0.text: It's them! They brought the curse! Drive them out!
say:12:1660212010:0.source_cn: 就是他们，是他们带来了诅咒，把他们都赶走！

say:14:1660212012:0.text: I won't turn my back on the helpless. That's not who we are!
say:14:1660212012:0.source_cn: 抛弃弱小的事，我绝不会做！

choice_prompt:16:1660212012.text: I won't turn my back on the helpless. That's not who we are!
choice_prompt:16:1660212012.source_cn: 抛弃弱小的事，我绝不会做！

say:18:1660212013:0.text: My friend... do you know who the dream has taken this time?
say:18:1660212013:0.source_cn: 我的朋友，你知道陷入梦境的是谁吗？
say:18:1660212013:0.male: My friend... do you know who the dream has taken this time?
say:18:1660212013:0.female: My friend... do you know who the dream has taken this time?

say:21:1660212014:1.text: Without warning, Bryon and the Maulers erupt into flames. Their bodies twist into burning fireballs, and they launch toward you and Soren!
say:21:1660212014:1.source_cn: 聚集在一起的蛮血，连同挡在你们面前的布莱恩，突然变成了...
say:21:1660212014:1.male: Without warning, Bryon and the Maulers erupt into flames. Their bodies twist into burning fireballs, and they launch toward you and Soren!
say:21:1660212014:1.female: Without warning, Bryon and the Maulers erupt into flames. Their bodies twist into burning fireballs, and they launch toward you and Soren!

say:22:1660212015:1.text: You grab Soren's arm and run. As the fire rains down, you begin to sing the Song of Spring.
say:22:1660212015:1.source_cn: 你一把抓住索恩，一边奔跑躲避着火雨，一边唱起了《春日之歌》。
say:22:1660212015:1.male: You grab Soren's arm and run. As the fire rains down, you begin to sing the Song of Spring.
say:22:1660212015:1.female: You grab Soren's arm and run. As the fire rains down, you begin to sing the Song of Spring.

say:23:1660212016:3.text: The moment your melody begins, a soft breeze answers, carrying with it a gentle rain.
say:23:1660212016:3.source_cn: 随着歌声响起，一阵缱绻的风吹来，风中又带着温柔的雨。

say:23:1660212016:3.female: The moment your melody begins, a soft breeze answers, carrying with it a gentle rain.

choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 布莱恩，你为什么不像以前一样找我帮忙？
choice:19:0:1.male: Bryon, why didn't you come to me for help like you used to?
choice:19:0:1.female: Bryon, why didn't you come to me for help like you used to?

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 别吵了，你们都只是在做梦
